contentEn:
Delta homeowners spent $15,000 to $55,000 on bathroom renovations in 2025. Reno Stars has completed seven bathroom and whole-house renovation projects in Delta over the past two years — this guide uses those real numbers for 2026 planning.

Delta BC Bathroom Renovation Cost Table 2026

ScopeCost Range (CAD)
Basic refresh (paint, vanity, toilet, flooring)$15,000–$22,000
Full reno (plumbing moves, retile, new layout)$28,000–$43,000
Luxury master bath (heated floors, custom tile, high-end fixtures)$50,000–$65,000

Every figure above comes from an actual completed Reno Stars contract in Delta, not an estimate or industry average.

Real Delta Project Examples from Reno Stars

3.5 Bathroom Full Reno (Tsawwassen): Three full baths + powder room, new showers, tubs, vanities, all tiling. Contract: $40,000–$43,000. Timeline: 7–9 weeks.

Whole House incl. 2 Baths (North Delta): Kitchen + two bathrooms + flooring, detached home. Timeline: 10–14 weeks.

Townhouse Bathroom (Ladner): Complete bath refresh — new tile, vanity, fixtures. Timeline: 3–5 weeks.

What Drives Cost in Delta

Plumbing relocation is the biggest cost driver. Moving a toilet, shower drain, or re-routing supply lines requires a Delta plumbing permit and adds $2,000–$6,000. Keeping plumbing positions unchanged is the most effective way to control your budget.

Shower and tile scope matters more than fixture brand. A standard tile shower with fixed glass costs $3,500–$6,000 for materials and labour. A curbless walk-in with linear drain, multiple body jets, and natural stone can reach $12,000–$18,000 before any plumbing moves.

Finish level drives the remaining spread. Solid-wood vanity with quartz countertop and brushed nickel fixtures costs $2,500–$5,000 more than a homecentre vanity-and-top combo. Most Delta homeowners Reno Stars works with choose solid Shaker-style vanities, quartz countertops, and brushed gold or matte black fixtures.

Delta Permits: What You Need to Know

Delta (Tsawwassen, Ladner, North Delta) falls under the Metro Vancouver building permit system. Moving plumbing fixtures requires a building permit from Delta. Cosmetic work — replacing a vanity, retiling a shower floor without moving the drain — does not need a building permit, but any work on supply or drain lines needs a plumbing permit.

For properties in Ladner built before 1960 that are in a heritage or protected zone, additional heritage review adds 2–4 weeks to the permit timeline. Reno Stars handles all permit applications as part of standard project management.

How Long Does a Bathroom Renovation Take in Delta?

A basic refresh: 3–5 weeks. A full renovation: 7–12 weeks. Permit processing adds 5–10 business days before work begins. Reno Stars coordinates all trades and inspections so the timeline stays on track.

Ready for a Delta bathroom renovation quote? Contact Reno Stars for a fixed-price estimate covering scope, timeline, and all required permits.
contentZh:
2025年，Delta業主的浴室翻新費用在$15,000至$55,000之間。Reno Stars在過去兩年內在Delta完成了七個浴室及全屋翻新項目——本指南使用這些真實數據進行2026年規劃。

Delta BC浴室裝修費用表 2026

工程範圍費用範圍（加元）
基本翻新（油漆、浴室櫃、馬桶、地板）$15,000–$22,000
全面翻新（管道移位、重新鋪磚、新佈局）$28,000–$43,000
豪華主臥浴室（地暖、定制瓷磚、高端五金件）$50,000–$65,000

以上每一項數據均來自Reno Stars在Delta的實際完工合同，非估算或行業平均值。

Reno Stars在Delta的真實項目案例

3.5間浴室全面翻新（Tsawwassen）：三間全套浴室+洗手間，新淋浴間、浴缸、浴室櫃，全部鋪磚。合同金額：$40,000–$43,000。工期：7–9週。

全屋翻新含2間浴室（北Delta）：廚房+兩間浴室+地板，獨立屋。工期：10–14週。

聯排別墅浴室（Ladner）：浴室全面翻新——新瓷磚、浴室櫃、五金件。工期：3–5週。

什麼因素驅動Delta的費用

管道遷移是最大的成本驅動因素。移動馬桶、淋浴間排水管或重新佈設供水管需要Delta管道許可證，並額外增加$2,000–$6,000。保持管道位置不變是控制預算的最有效方式。

淋浴間和鋪磚範圍比五金品牌更重要。標準瓷磚淋浴間配固定玻璃隔板，材料和人工費用通常為$3,500–$6,000。無障礙步入式淋浴間配線性地漏、多個身體噴頭和天然石材，在任何管道改動之前就可能達到$12,000–$18,000。

飾面檔次涵蓋浴室櫃、檯面、水龍頭和照明選擇。實木浴室櫃配石英石檯面和拉絲鎳五金件，比家居商場的組合高出$2,500–$5,000。Reno Stars在Delta合作的大多數業主選擇實木Shaker風格浴室櫃、石英石檯面和拉絲金或啞光黑五金件。

Delta許可證：您需要了解的

Delta（Tsawwassen、Ladner、北Delta）屬於大溫哥華建築許可體系。移動管道裝置需要向Delta申請建築許可證。美化翻新——更換浴室櫃、在不改變排水口位置的情況下重新鋪淋浴間地板——不需要建築許可證，但任何供水或排水管道的工程都需要管道許可證。

對於Ladner 1960年前建造且位於文物或保護區的房產，額外的保護區審查會使許可時間表延長約2–4週。Reno Stars作為標準項目管理的一部分處理所有許可證申請。

Delta浴室裝修需要多長時間？

基本翻新：3–5週。全面翻新：7–12週。許可證處理在工作開始前增加5–10個工作日。Reno Stars協調所有工程和檢驗，確保時間表保持正常。
